hypotheses.claim: Natural content-reaction mismatch creates real selectable headroom between content and historical experts

primary_endpoint.timepoint: OOF train and frozen dev only

success.condition: Paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for Oracle improvement is above zero after registered controls

failure.condition: No stable controlled mismatch or no Oracle headroom
failure.claim_impact: Remove historical-routing claim; retain content-only reliability or negative result

inconclusive.condition: CI crosses zero or natural groups disagree
inconclusive.claim_impact: No router claim and no test access

hypotheses.claim: Credible posterior OOF net-benefit routing improves matched-coverage JSD and reduces credible negative transfer beyond point and generic gates

primary_endpoint.metric: 90%-coverage JSD difference then credible negative-transfer-rate difference
primary_endpoint.timepoint: Frozen dev; formal test reserved for Task50

success.condition: Fixed-sequence paired-bootstrap CI upper bounds are below zero for JSD and credible negative transfer

failure.condition: Not better than point/generic gate or no natural-OOD harm reduction
failure.claim_impact: Use point routing, ordinary retrieval, or content-only; remove credible-net-benefit claim

inconclusive.condition: CI crosses zero, insufficient precision, or direction varies by natural group

hypotheses.claim: Group disagreement, finite-response sampling and model/OOD uncertainty have separately testable value

primary_endpoint.metric: Source-specific external criteria and empirical-distribution region coverage/efficiency

success.condition: Each retained source passes its own Holm-adjusted external criterion and regions report target coverage with finite width
success.claim_impact: Only passing sources may be named separately

failure.condition: Sources are not identifiable or regions systematically miscover
failure.claim_impact: Report total uncertainty only or delete region claim

inconclusive.condition: Precision insufficient or exchangeability boundary unresolved

guardrails.claim_impact: formal evidence invalid until independent review

stopping.rule: Stage-gated fixed-data development; no optional stopping on favorable metrics
stopping.limit: Maximum 12 trials per trainable family; five frozen algorithm seeds; 200 thinning replicates per item/k
stopping.action_on_exhaustion: Report failure or inconclusive; do not expand model or inspect formal test
